contexts.text: Like a beast before a cart...

The new cart on which they sent back the ark = new doctrine, or natural doctrine; for a chariot = doctrine from spiritual truths... The cows together with the cart being offered for a burnt-offerings that thus the Lord is propitiated. TCR 203:2.
A cart = the doctrine of natural truth, and a new cart, that doctrine unimpaired and not defiled by their falsities of evil.
